info.title: Chaos Commerce Store API
info.description: Public Storefront API authenticated by Store-scoped publishable keys.

get.summary: Resolve a verified active Store and Web Sales Channel from the HTTP Host
get.description: This public bootstrap lookup does not authenticate commerce access. Pending, archived, inactive, and non-Web bindings resolve as not found.

get.summary: List active and published Products with active prices

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Active Collection handle published to the current Sales Channel. Results preserve manual Collection order.

get.summary: Get one active and published Product by handle
List active Collections published to the current Sales Channel
Get an active Collection published to the current Sales Channel

post.summary: Collect a bounded batch of consent-aware first-party behavior events
post.description: Browser events are untrusted observations and cannot declare commercial amounts, Order state, Payment state, or other authoritative outcomes.

200.description: Batch accepted, deduplicated, or discarded according to consent and the effective Store Analytics Policy

post.summary: Link an anonymous Analytics identity to the authenticated Customer
post.description: Requires current analytics-storage consent and an effective Store Analytics Policy that enables identity linking. Customer identity is never returned.

post.summary: Create an anonymous possession-bound shopper session
Create an active Cart using the current Price List

put.summary: Add a Cart line or replace its quantity and current snapshot

post.summary: Quote active Shipping Services for a Cart destination
Freeze Cart prices and reserve tracked inventory atomically
Create an Order from an immutable Checkout snapshot

get.summary: Get an Order and its transition audit trail

post.summary: Associate the possession-bound shopper with the authenticated Store Customer

get.summary: Get the authenticated Store Customer and saved addresses

put.summary: Update the authenticated Store Customer phone

post.summary: Create a saved address for the authenticated Store Customer

delete.summary: Delete a saved address without changing Checkout or Order snapshots

get.summary: List Order history for the authenticated Store Customer

post.summary: Create a Payment Attempt and enqueue a provider command atomically

get.summary: Get a Payment Attempt visible to this Store and Sales Channel
Retrieve the short-lived client action for a pending Payment Attempt
get.description: Returns provider-neutral client handoff material only to the shopper that owns the Payment Attempt. The client token must never be logged, cached, or placed in a URL.

200.description: Payment client action. The response includes `Cache-Control: no-store`.

publishableKey.description: A Store-scoped publishable key with the scope declared by the operation.

Currency.name: currency
Currency.description: Enabled Store currency. Defaults to the Store default currency.

ShopperToken.name: x-chaos-shopper-token
ShopperToken.description: Signed possession credential returned by shopper-session creation and echoed by Cart creation. Never place this value in URLs or logs.

CustomerSession.name: x-chaos-customer-session
CustomerSession.description: Opaque verified User session used in addition to the Store publishable key.

shopper_token.description: Signed possession credential for one anonymous shopper session.
Returned only by Cart creation. Persist securely and send as x-chaos-shopper-token for this resource lineage.

shipping_address.description: Required when any Cart line requires shipping

shipping_service_id.description: Required for shippable Carts and revalidated when Checkout is created

promotion_code.description: Optional redemption code revalidated when Checkout is created

Forbidden.description: Credential class or scope is not allowed

NotFound.description: Resource not found or not visible to this Store credential

Conflict.description: Idempotency conflict, terminal Cart, stale price, or insufficient inventory

ValidationFailed.description: Invalid header, body, query, or path value

RateLimited.description: Store, Sales Channel, or anonymous-identity collection budget exceeded

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current fixed collection window expires

Unavailable.description: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable
